data.name: Mohinder
data.long_meaning: Mohinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mohana' meaning 'to attract' and 'indra' meaning 'moon'. The name signifies one who attracts the moon or one who is of the mind of Indra. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of the gods and the deity of rain.
